mainText: <speak><voice name="Salli">Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a temperature of 84 degrees, feeling like 86, near the Verona Public Library. Under today's full moon, we unfortunately have no visible space station passes to report.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Ivy">The City of Verona is currently running an I Voted sticker design contest featuring student artwork. Residents are encouraged to vote online or at City Hall for their favorite designs through August 7, with the winning selections appearing on stickers for the November election.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joanna">We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or trivia at The Bogey Factory.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kimberly">Looking at the weekly police report, on July 26, an officer conducted a traffic stop for a vehicle traveling 97 miles per hour, resulting in the driver being arrested for an O W I.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joey">Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Georgia Peach flavor of the day at Culver's. They are open until 10 PM, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.</voice></speak>
